Name: Easy Prairie King - Journey of the Prairie King Difficulty Changer (Fastest Fector's Challenge achievement)
Author: spineshank3042
Description:
[b]StardewValleyEasyPrairieKing / Difficulty Changer for Journey of the Prairie King[/b]

This is a mod for Stardew Valley which adds options to change difficulty of the minigame *Journey of the Prairie King*.
It was made to make it easy to achieve the Fector's Challenge and Prairie King achievements.


You can now also increase difficulty!



[b]Install
[/b]
Install with vortex or

1. [url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url]
2. Download this mod from Nexus mods.
3. Unzip the download and place the folder into your [code]Mods[/code] folder.



[b]Compatibility[/b]
 * Should work with Stardew Valley 1.6 on Linux/Mac/Windows. (Only tested on Linux)

[b]Requirements[/b]

Stardew Modding API (SMAPI) 4.0.0 or above.

[b]Console Commands
[/b]
added console commands in version 0.5.
Type [i]prairie_help [/i]into your smapi console to get all available commands, (If you use chat commands then type[i] /prairie_help[/i] )


[b]Configuration

[/b]
If you install the[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098?tab=files&file_id=82653] Generic Mod Config[/url] mod you can configure the mod via the mod menu.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/5816/5816-1723557238-683926660.jpeg[/img]


Alternatively you can edit the json directly.

A *config.json* file will be generated the first time you run this mod. This file will look like this:

{
  "alwaysInvincible": false,
  "lives": 98,
  "coins": 100,
  "ammoLevel": 0,
  "bulletDamage": 0,
  "fireSpeedLevel": 5,
  "runSpeedLevel": 2,
  "useShotgun": true,
  "useWeel": true,
  "waveTimer": 60
}

To enable always_invincible or spread_pistol(shoot 3 bullets at once) set it to true.
To disable always_invincible or spread_pistol(shoot 3 bullets at once) set it to false.

To enable the feature(s) you want, just set those values [u][b]bigger than[/b] 0[/u]. (e.g. 5 or 90)
To disable the feature(s) you don't want, just set those features to 0.

waveTimer is the time per stage in seconds. By default I decreased the time from 80 to 60 seconds per stage.

To set your [b]lives[/b] or [b]coins[/b] to [b]infinite[/b] set it to [b]100[/b].

You could also set your lives to 1, then you will start with only 1 live for an insane mode.
